correctness.rationale: All variables, Euclidean norms, affine projections and real trace range are explicit. Two projected coordinate-normal norms are reconstructed from symmetric Frobenius gradients. Sharp summed linear obstructions are attained at the invariant point; equality in these sums gives all optimizers, threshold, dimensions and contacts. Half-integral center vertices follow from an independent incidence-rank argument, not the numerical tests. The script independently reconstructed norms and 49 LP optima.

value.rationale: For trace-fixed reversible uniform-stationary kernels, the result determines the natural full intrinsic Frobenius incenter classification in every dimension n>=4 and every real interior trace. Its sharp threshold tends to sqrt(2), the optimal-center dimension collapses from n(n-3)/2 to 0, and a fractional perfect matching polytope controls all low-trace centers and their odd-cycle support vertices. This structure is not implied by merely knowing the uniform center or the unsliced vertex list.
